New York: a bid for a stainless-steel Voutilainen chronograph at Phillips' online watch sale has nearly tripled its $240,000 estimate, reaching $700,000.

The 88-lot New York Sessions sale runs through October 9. Two F.P. Journe watches have also broken their high estimates, and a Jaeger-LeCoultre Atmos clock built around Gustav Klimt's 'The Kiss' is also on offer.

New York's trade, just over the Hudson: federal prosecutors charged six New Jersey men in a string of jewelry store smash-and-grab robberies that reached Staten Island.

DNA from broken glass at a May 2025 Paterson robbery linked two men, the U.S. Attorney's Office in Newark says. "Customers found themselves caught in the middle of violent robberies," said FBI Newark's Stephanie Roddy.
